[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 420
- Description: China market entry — field research compilation & decision memo (Gary Teh, 7h)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1841
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1837
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1840
  
  Details:
  Direct time: 7 hours of governor effort compiling and directing the China market-entry research package.
  
  What was produced across the working window (2026-11-11 → 2026-11-13):
  
  • 4-store Dongguan field visit (嘉荣 SPAR, 山姆会员商店 Sam's Club, 超盒算NB, blt 万象汇 MixC) — 107 photographs, 22 distinct SKUs price-tagged at shelf, spanning ¥113/kg to ¥1,250/kg.
  • CHINA_MARKET_ENTRY_DECISIONS.md v4 — 25-page decision memo covering brand architecture (F5 vs Agroverse pivot), SKU format (single-estate Oscar's Farm Bahia vs superseded 4-estate box), channel, packaging differentiation, and pricing.
  • Two rendered PDFs delivered to the #chinese-dark-chocolate-bar thread: a 14-page compiled research synthesis (CJK-embedded, reconciled against v4) and a 5-page field-findings report restricted to the 4 stops.
  • Verified source-checking pass against the live Oscar's Farm page, the 107-photo EXIF archive, and primary PRC statute (Advertising Law Arts. 9(8)/9(9)/17, GB 28050, GB 7718-2025, Religious Affairs Regulations).
  
  Key findings the compilation established:
  • The above-80%-cacao segment is growing 21%/yr — ~3x the category rate — in a small, value-led market (~RMB 24bn, 0.1 kg/capita).
  • No product across 22 SKUs combined a named single estate, vintage/lot, third-party assay, and per-unit QR traceability. Provenance is the one unoccupied shelf position.
  • Cacao percentage carries no price premium at the premium tier (50% and 70% both ¥18.90 at blt, same 75g); channel drives a measurable +27% premium for the identical SKU.
  • A source-verified correction: the Oscar's Farm wrapper line "HEIRLOOM CENTURY-OLD TREES" is mis-stated — the farm is 100 years old, the trees are 80. Flagged as the highest-priority item before any print run.
  
  Type: Time (Minutes), Amount: 420 (7 hours), TDG computed by rubric at 100 TDG/hour.

  • https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1837 — field audit & SWOT
  • https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1840 — ERRATA_V2 independent review
